name: cache-description-cap
title: dsh-find-ideas: truncate repository descriptions at the cache entry point
description: Truncate and whitespace-fold GitHub descriptions to 512 characters inside toCandidate before they are cached, bump CACHE_VERSION 2->3, and rewrite the render.ts comment that currently justifies deferring the cap to render time.
